const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""DexToolBench brush / red_brush / sweep_forward controller record.
+
+This is a small, hand-written visual servo/grasp attempt for the standard
+Robot client. It uses only the advertised cameras, calibration, task goal and
+joint proprioception. No simulator model or object state is read.
+
+The service trajectory is the authoritative record. Running this file submits
+commands to the live episode and must not be used to reset it.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMS = ["front", "side", "top", "oblique"]
+
+
+def connect():
+    r = Robot(timeout=120)
+    s = r.spec()
+    assert s["protocol"].startswith("eai-standard/2.")
+    return r, s
+
+
+def observe(r, save_to=None):
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video="both")
+    if save_to:
+        o.save(str(save_to))
+    return o
+
+
+def send_pose(r, q, hand, seconds, note):
+    """Send one ramped joint-position row from measured current state."""
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS)
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    cmd = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), np.asarray(hand, dtype=float)]
+    res = r.submit(
+        "joint_position", cmd[None, :], dt=float(seconds),
+        interpolate="linear", cameras=CAMS, video="frames", video_fps=3,
+        include_depth=True, note=note,
+    )
+    return res
+
+
+def open_hand():
+    # HA4 layout: thumb (5), index (4), middle (4), ring (4), pinky (5).
+    return np.zeros(22, dtype=float)
+
+
+def wrap_hand():
+    # Thumb opposition plus a four-finger wrap around the brush handle.
+    h = np.zeros(22, dtype=float)
+    h[:5] = [1.75, -0.30, 1.35, -0.30, 1.70]
+    for b in (5, 9, 13):
+        h[b:b + 4] = [1.55, 0.0, 1.74, 1.39]
+    h[17:22] = [0.25, 1.55, 0.0, 1.74, 1.39]
+    return h
+
+
+def run():
+    r, spec = connect()
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    start = observe(r, OUT / "gen_start")
+    state = np.asarray(start.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = state[:7].copy()
+    record = {
+        "protocol": spec["protocol"],
+        "control_dt": spec["control_dt"],
+        "start_task": start.meta.get("task"),
+        "actions": [],
+    }
+
+    # The table-plane placement was estimated from dark tool pixels and
+    # calibrated RGB-D views. Approach the visible tool with the open hand.
+    q[0], q[1], q[2] = -1.52, 1.68, -0.32
+    q[3], q[4], q[5], q[6] = 1.40, 0.0, 1.47, 1.31
+    try:
+        res = send_pose(r, q, open_hand(), 1.0, "open-hand visual approach")
+        record["actions"].append({"note": "open-hand visual approach", "meta": res.meta})
+        res.save(str(OUT / "gen_approach"))
+
+        res = send_pose(r, q, wrap_hand(), 1.2, "close around visible brush handle")
+        record["actions"].append({"note": "close around visible brush handle", "meta": res.meta})
+        res.save(str(OUT / "gen_grasp"))
+
+        # Lift a short distance and use the cameras/task index as feedback.
+        q[1] = 1.42
+        res = send_pose(r, q, wrap_hand(), 1.2, "lift check")
+        record["actions"].append({"note": "lift check", "meta": res.meta})
+        res.save(str(OUT / "gen_lift"))
+        record["end_task"] = res.meta.get("task")
+        record["done"] = res.meta.get("done", False)
+        record["reason"] = res.meta.get("reason")
+    except EpisodeOver as e:
+        record["episode_over"] = str(e)
+    finally:
+        try:
+            record["status"] = r.status()
+        except Exception as e:
+            record["status_error"] = repr(e)
+        (OUT / "gen_record.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
